title: TCMPB General Advisory on Acupuncture and Other Related Treatment

source.title: General Advisory on Acupuncture and Other Related Treatment (2021)
source.publisher: Traditional Chinese Medicine Practitioners Board (TCMPB), Singapore
source.note: Cited by the design proposal as covering infection prevention, needle safety, treatment records and consent, including single-use sterile needles and appropriate disposal. The document could not be fetched in this session: each rule below is a simulation encoding of the proposal's summary and must be checked against the advisory's text, clause by clause, before use.

review.notes: Encoded from the proposal's summary, not from the advisory's text. The effective date is taken as the publication month (June 2021).

rules.title: Single-use sterile needles
rules.summary: Use sterile, single-use acupuncture needles; a needle is never reused.

rules.title: Dispose of needles as sharps
rules.summary: Used needles are disposed of appropriately, into a sharps container.

rules.title: Hand hygiene
rules.summary: Infection prevention: hand hygiene before handling sterile needles and needling.

rules.title: Prepare the needling site
rules.summary: Infection prevention: the skin at the needling site is prepared before insertion.

rules.title: Consent before treatment
rules.summary: The patient's consent to the treatment is obtained before it is given.

rules.title: Treatment records
rules.summary: Treatment records are kept: the assessment, the points used and the procedure performed.
